Title: Senior Data Engineer
Description: Senior Data Engineer Location: Guadalajara - Hybrid ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY At Salesloft, our Senior Data Engineers build the pipelines and infrastructure that move, transform, and secure data across the company. You will build the data foundations that power our security analytics, internal reporting, and the trustworthy data flows the business depends on — engineering pipelines that are reliable, well-governed, and built to scale. This is a hands-on data engineering role with real ownership. You will design and build data pipelines, model data for analytics and security use cases, and ensure data quality and governance across the systems you own. Working within our Security and data organization, you will engineer data infrastructure that treats security, privacy, and reliability as first-class requirements. On a day-to-day basis, you will: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that move and transform data across systems reliably. Model and structure data for analytics, reporting, and security use cases. Ensure data quality, lineage, and governance across the pipelines and datasets you own. Build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers security analytics and internal decision-making. Partner with security, analytics, and business teams to deliver trustworthy, well-governed data. Automate and harden data workflows, treating reliability and security as first-class concerns. This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll build durable, well-governed data infrastructure and fix root causes of data quality issues rather than patching pipelines each time they break. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll engineer data flows that respect the security and privacy of the data customers trust us with. What We're Looking For We are looking for an experienced data engineer who builds reliable, well-governed pipelines and cares about data quality and security. You own your data infrastructure end to end and think about reliability, lineage, and governance as core to the job. You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you validate data quality rigorously, trace issues to their true source, and are candid about data limitations. You think in systems and build pipelines designed to last. This is the right role if you want to build the data foundations that a category-defining company runs on. THE TEAM The Salesloft Security and data organization protects and governs the data the company and its customers depend on. Senior Data Engineers build the pipelines and infrastructure behind security analytics and trustworthy internal data, working closely with Security, Analytics, and business teams. The team Moves as One — data engineering, security, and analytics share ownership of reliable, well-governed data and coordinate directly. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: our customers' success is the only scorecard that matters, and well-governed, secure data infrastructure is part of how we protect the company and its customers. THE SKILL SET Strong experience as a data engineer building and maintaining production data pipelines. Proficiency in SQL and a major programming language (e.g., Python) used for data engineering. Experience with modern data pipeline and orchestration tooling and cloud data platforms. Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance practices. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP). Experience building data infrastructure for security analytics or other sensitive-data use cases. Familiarity with streaming data systems (Kafka, Kinesis) and modern warehouse/lakehouse platforms. Exposure to data infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. Title: Senior Data and AI Governance Analyst
Description: Job Title: Senior Data and AI Governance Analyst Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara. ABOUT THE COMPANY: Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth. We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome. Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you. THE OPPORTUNITY Own the data governance, AI governance, and DLP programs that earn and keep customer trust as Salesloft scales its AI-powered revenue platform. As our Data Governance Senior Analyst, you’ll own and mature key parts of our data governance, AI governance, and DLP programs as a member of our fast-growing Governance, Risk, and Compliance team. Your work will make sure the customer data behind our Predictive Revenue System and the Revenue Context it delivers is classified, handled, and protected responsibly, including every data flow into and out of our AI systems. You’ll partner with Product and Engineering leadership to build privacy-by-design and responsible AI into new features early in the roadmap. In your first six months you will: Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of our data governance program, including data classification, data handling standards, and data lifecycle and retention policies. Build and operate our AI governance program, including AI policies and standards, an inventory of AI systems, models, and AI-enabled vendor tools, and a risk-based intake and approval process for new AI use cases. Own configuration, monitoring, and tuning of our DLP tooling and controls, serving as the escalation point for complex or high-risk DLP alerts and data handling incidents. HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role) Move as One: You’ll partner directly with Product, Engineering, Security, Sales, and Customer Success, and share credit when governance is built into the work from the start. Evidence over Ego: You’ll ground every risk assessment and policy in real data flows, and say so when the evidence changes your mind. Lead from the Front: You’ll own our data governance, AI governance, and DLP programs end to end, and mentor junior team members along the way. Customer-Inspired: You’ll turn customer data governance, AI governance, and security questions into clear standards that earn their trust. What We’re Looking For You’re a seasoned data and AI governance professional who balances regulatory rigor with practical business judgment, explains complex data handling and AI risk clearly to technical and executive audiences, and is excited to build something meaningful in a fast-moving SaaS environment. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move. YOU’LL BRING (must-haves, max 5–6) 5+ years in data governance, AI governance, DLP, information security, or a related compliance role (3+ with a Master’s degree, or equivalent work experience), working independently and reviewed primarily at critical milestones Owned data governance frameworks with minimal oversight, including data inventories, data mapping, records of processing, retention schedules, and data classification Hands-on experience with DLP tools and data classification/labeling technologies (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Symantec/Broadcom DLP, Netskope, Forcepoint, or similar), including independently investigating and remediating complex DLP alerts and data handling incidents Working knowledge of AI governance and responsible AI practices (AI risk assessments, AI system and model inventories, model documentation, human oversight controls) and of how data flows through AI and machine learning systems, with familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act Strong working knowledge of GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other major privacy regulations, plus privacy-by-design and data minimization principles, with a track record of influencing Product, Engineering, and Security leadership on data handling decisions Strong project leadership and communication: you manage multiple workstreams, mentor others, build relationships with senior internal and external partners through persuasion and negotiation, and translate complex data handling, AI risk, and regulatory requirements into clear guidance for technical and executive audiences IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 experience Experience leading data protection impact assessments (DPIAs/PIAs) for new products, features, and third-party relationships Experience responding to complex customer data governance, AI governance, and security questionnaires and due diligence requests THE TEAM Our Salesloft Governance, Risk, and Compliance team is made up of seasoned and up-and-coming Compliance and Security professionals working toward one goal: earning and keeping customer trust as we scale our AI-powered revenue platform. We share intellectual curiosity, a bias toward action, a collaborative spirit, and a genuine commitment to doing the right thing for our customers, our employees, and our business. It’s a great place to grow your data governance expertise in a fast-paced, AI-forward environment. BENEFITS: Your well-being matters to us.
